verdict.rationale: Raygun documents custom alerts to email, Slack or Teams, a Slack integration for APM trace messages, and PagerDuty incidents created when an APM rule triggers, so multi-channel alert delivery from rules exists. The evidence does not show routing by project, environment or severity, or per-rule thresholds for new issues, frequency spikes or affected-user counts. Spike protection concerns usage volume, not alert thresholds. Missing for 10: routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds for new-issue/frequency-spike/affected-user triggers, crash-reporting (not just APM) PagerDuty/Slack rule configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count

citations.quote: Alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Get custom alerts to where your team already works
Now when an issue is triggered from this rule, a PagerDuty incident will be created and your incident team will be notified by PagerDuty.
Select the Slack channel you would like APM trace messages to be sent to and click "Authorize".
